title: Одежда Таис — восемь вариантов V5
publication_authorization: Пользователь попросил опубликовать раздел «Одежда» и карточку одежды Таис с этими вариантами.
design_note: Самодельная рабочая одежда: military heritage и утилитарный techwear. Крой, воротники и цвета — предложения для экранизации.

items.title: Синий верх / светлый низ
items.prompt:
Edit reference image 1, preserving face, body, pose, existing practical jacket construction and loose trouser cut. Image 2 is an additional face anchor. CHANGE ONLY THESE CLOTHING DETAILS: make the jacket a distinctly DEEP PETROL BLUE, with dark muted-olive elbow and flap donor panels, while trousers become clearly LIGHT SAND / OFF-WHITE cotton drill with slightly darker beige knee reinforcements. Strong unmistakable light-dark separation between upper and lower half, not muddy gray. Replace ordinary collar with a more interesting REWORKED MILITARY DOUBLE COLLAR: broad blue stand-and-fall outer collar, one side naturally folded outward revealing RUST-BROWN fine wool facing, a short flat asymmetric throat tab secured by one salvaged button, and a narrow dark inner stand collar. It frames neck with useful warmth, no tall face cover or fashion spikes. Preserve hand-sewn plausibility, all usable pockets and roomy wide hems. No other change.

Maintain the user's preferred HANDMADE UTILITY direction: military heritage mixed with subtle practical techwear, old clothes re-cut by the station's teenagers using ordinary sewing tools. Matte cotton drill, faded canvas, wool/knit inserts, simple reused zippers, buttons and snaps. Repair only actual stress points, slightly mismatched donor panels and believable seams. Interesting construction must be physically sewable, not sculptural couture, origami, runway bolero, armor or a luxury technical product. No weapons, futuristic glowing trim, combat webbing, MOLLE or decorative harness. NO HANGING CORDS, DRAWSTRING CUFFS, BOWS, RIBBONS OR DANGLING STRAP ENDS. Headcloth ends and short boot laces tucked. Collars are fabric with plausible seams and simple fasteners; keep them below chin, open enough to see face and braids, no mask. Clothes fully cover torso and waist, opaque and modest. New full-length trousers MUST remain LOOSE AND STRAIGHT through thigh, knees and calves, with BROAD OPEN HEMS over boots. No skinny, slim-fit, tapered ankles, joggers, elastic gathered cuffs or tied hems. Character is slender, clothing is roomy. Design proposals based on ALIVE life: limited garments, re-cutting, cold passages, carrying supplies and laundry; not new literal book facts.

One realistic full-body photographic costume study of the SAME fictional teenage Tais, almost seventeen, short and slim, two dark ash-brown braids, side fringe, black-and-white patterned headcloth with tucked ends, honey-brown eyes, natural freckled face. Preserve exact facial geometry and age from the face reference; calm alert expression, no makeup or adult glamour. Entire head and both boot soles within portrait 2:3 frame with margin. Same quiet gray station landing, pale side panels, small warm work light, realistic worn floor. Same camera scale and relaxed three-quarter standing pose with hands visible. Natural anatomy, two arms/two legs, five fingers, coherent knees and grounded boots. 50mm perspective, controlled face focus, softly separated background. Center front heavy salvaged zipper stops at upper hip; no belt or hanging waist ties. Full sleeves loose, simple dark elbow repairs. Two asymmetrical chest pockets, one navy donor panel, plus big usable hip pockets. Legs are generously WIDE AND STRAIGHT all the way to broad open hems falling over brown boots, no cuff gathering or taper. Distinctive collar: tall-but-soft NAVY split stand collar with one folded mustard wing and a small flat copper-colored snap, collar below chin. Industrial, youthful, useful; looks like an inventive homemade maintenance jumpsuit, not pilot uniform or cosplay. items.title: Тёплый смок из одеяла
items.prompt:
NEW BOLD DESIGN 07 — compact HANDMADE BLANKET SMOCK for a cold base, with a wide squared upper-body silhouette. A faded DEEP BRICK-RED wool/cotton blanket has been sewn into a SHORT HIP-LENGTH wide sleeveless-over-sleeves smock with short integrated shoulder caps ending around upper arm, broad front foldover opening, two huge simple front pockets and rectangular side panels. This is an ordinary purposeful sewn smock, NOT fashion cape, long poncho or ceremonial tabard. The sides are SEWN CLOSED from armpit to hem with gussets; garment cannot flap or snag like a cape. Underneath a full-sleeved SAND / OATMEAL waffle-knit work shirt fully covers arms and waist; visible long cuffs. FULL-LENGTH LOOSE STRAIGHT LIGHT SAGE-GRAY WORK TROUSERS with broad open hems, plain deep side-entry pockets and durable patched knees. A bold SOFT SHAWL/FUNNEL HYBRID COLLAR uses oatmeal blanket facing: asymmetric overlap across upper chest, a simple flat wooden-looking dark button keeps one side down, open well below chin, no tied scarf.
